transcript: This public message contains a rule and a reason. This is a weather update for the area around the train station. Heavy rain is expected after three thirty. Outdoor practice will end early, and the river path will close for the evening. Students walking home should use the station road, not the lower bridge. Families will receive another message if the warning changes.
